title: Theme profiles and accent
summary: Runtime theme engine: THEMES table of named profiles (28 at formvis 1.98.4, the NodeMode 14 plus extras), readChoice/saveChoice/applyTheme, accent and intensity, user skins. Persists under localStorage key nodemode_ui_settings, shared with NodeMode by contract.
description: Profiles overwrite the theme-owned tokens (`--bg-*`, `--border-*`, `--text-*`, `--canvas-bg`, `--grid-color`) on `documentElement`; `applyTheme` also writes the derived `--bg-node`, `--shadow-lg`, the accent and its dim/hover/tint variants and toggles `body.theme-light`. The B06 id says 14 because the NodeMode set is 14; the table in formvis 1.98.4 holds 28 entries, so a port should decide which to keep. The choice is stored as `{theme, accentColor, intensity, appearance}` with an appearance generation (3 at this commit). `?no-skin` on the address starts with the default look. Keep the table in step with the pre-paint boot snippet (`theme.prepaint-boot`).
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.signature: export interface ThemeProfile { label: string; vars: Record<string, string>; light?: boolean; css?: string }
exports.doc: One theme: display label, the CSS variables it sets on documentElement, a light flag and optional free skin CSS.
The profile table keyed by theme id (28 entries at formvis 1.98.4); the default is studio.
Id of the default profile, studio (Studio Dark).
Default accent colour, orange #f97316.
The redesign's first default accent, moved to orange by appearance 3 unless it was chosen on purpose.
Default accent intensity, 1.
The app persists UI settings under this key as JSON {theme, accentColor, ...}

exports.signature: export interface ThemeChoice { theme: string; accentColor: string; intensity?: number }
exports.doc: The persisted choice: theme id, accent colour and optional accent intensity.
The appearance generation: a choice saved before Studio Dark (Phase 21) lacks it and is set aside once, so the redesign reaches everyone. Generation 3 (1.48.1): the accent defaults to orange;
True when the page address carries ?no-skin, so the default look is shown and the saved choice is kept.
Reads the saved ThemeChoice from nodemode_ui_settings (appearance generation 3, or 2 migrated); returns the defaults when absent, blocked or ?no-skin.
Merges a ThemeChoice into the nodemode_ui_settings JSON and stamps the appearance generation; storage failures are logged, not thrown.

exports.signature: export function applyTheme(choice: ThemeChoice = readChoice()): void
exports.doc: Apply a profile and accent to the document. Mirrors applySettings(): profile vars first, then the derived --bg-node and --shadow-lg the profiles do not declare, then the accent and its dim variant.
The reason a skin's CSS is refused, or '' when it passes: no network (url, @import, @font-face), no script, no escapes, only @media, braces balanced. The engine lints the same way.

exports.signature: export interface UserSkin { id: string; label: string; light: boolean; version: string; author: string; vars: Record<string, string>; css?: string }
exports.doc: A user-supplied skin: id, label, light flag, version, author, variable map and optional free CSS.
localStorage key holding the active user skin so the boot script can paint it.

exports.signature: export function registerSkins(skins: UserSkin[]): { added: string[]; removed: string[] }
exports.doc: Skins from the data folder's skins folder become themes named skin-<file>; the ones loaded before are replaced. The ids gone and the ids new are returned so a picker can patch its swatches in place.
Saves the theme, applies it and dispatches nm:ui-settings-changed with detail.key theme.
Preferences > Interface: how strongly the accent tints what it marks (0 to 1.5; 1 is the design's).
Saves the accent colour, applies it and dispatches nm:ui-settings-changed with detail.key accentColor.

exports.signature: export function themeSwatchesHtml(active: string = readChoice().theme, accent: string = readChoice().accentColor): string
exports.doc: Swatch markup for a theme picker, the app's .nm-theme-swatch recipe: background is the profile's --bg-secondary, the active swatch borders in the accent, every other swatch in its own --border-color.

invariants.text: The persisted appearance key is nodemode_ui_settings and is shared with NodeMode by contract; its name and the appearance generation field must not change.

Build a node once, then patch text, classes, hidden flags and lists in place. Never assign innerHTML or clear textContent on a live container to rebuild it, and reserve space so nothing shifts when content arrives.
The THEMES table and the inline PROFILES table of the pre-paint boot snippet list the same ids and the same ten surface values; change both together.
applyTheme is never called from a component first render; it runs once at boot and on a theme change, so a second repaint cannot happen.
